pitch:
Mama Fit, a home strength program for mums after birth, made by a mum of three who has been through it.
Workouts for your pelvic floor, tummy gap (diastasis), core, legs and arms. 8 exercises, 3 sets of 10, about 45 minutes a day, no equipment needed beyond the floor.
Start with a free 5-week program. Then the 8-week program is a one-off AUD 19.99, no subscription.
Follow-along videos in a web app you open from Instagram. No diets, just movement.
Check with your GP or physio before starting.
